assets.prompt: Use case: text-localization. Edit target: the attached RINGSIDE game menu art. Change ONLY the title and tiny ring-apron branding. Replace the enormous left-side English RING / SIDE title with exact Chinese game title "暴打严俊杰". Typography must be FIVE correct characters: 暴 打 严 俊 杰. Place "暴打" on the first line and "严俊杰" on the second line in the same left-side region as the old title, huge beveled brushed-chrome metallic Chinese lettering with black depth and red rim light, retaining the aggressive WWE-like premium PPV style and red underline. IMPORTANT use 严 (not 闫) in this title. Replace small RINGSIDE brand on bottom-right ring apron with "暴打严俊杰" or a red slash if too small. Preserve everything else: landscape aspect ratio, original composition, dark empty lower-left area for button overlays, right-side wrestling ring and red ropes, stadium, crowd, smoke, lighting, THE MAIN EVENT text. Do not add people, buttons, extra text, cards or UI.

Use case: identity-preserve. Edit target: the attached studio photograph of an adult bald man in thin rectangular eyeglasses, charcoal suit, black shirt and red boxing gloves. Produce one photorealistic staged after-a-boxing-match photograph of this SAME man. Preserve his identity, facial proportions, bald head, glasses, suit, black shirt and red gloves. Show visible but NON-GRAPHIC theatrical sports bruising: blue-purple discoloration around one eye and on cheekbones, a mildly puffy cheek and slightly swollen reddened nose, a tired rueful expression. Keep eyes visible and facial features recognizable. No blood, no open wounds, no severe injury, no disfigurement. Frame from upper thighs to above head, with enough facial detail to clearly see the bruised makeup. Keep the clean light gray studio backdrop and soft professional photographic lighting. No text, no watermark, no other people. This is a fictional boxing-game character promotional photo with movie makeup, not documentation of a real event.

Use case: compositing. Edit target Image 1: existing homepage game banner, with Chinese metallic title 暴打严俊杰 and a red wrestling arena. Image 2: identity and facial-bruising reference for the SAME adult bald man with thin rectangular glasses, charcoal suit, black shirt and red boxing gloves. Create a finished production game homepage banner by adding a very large photorealistic HEAD-AND-SHOULDERS PORTRAIT of that man onto the RIGHT HALF of Image 1. His bruised face is the visual focus on the right: recognizable bald head, thin glasses, blue-purple bruising around his eye and cheeks, a red swollen nose and puffy cheek, rueful tired expression. Non-graphic boxing makeup, no blood, no open wounds. Crop the portrait at upper chest: this is a BIG HEADSHOT, NOT a full-body boxer. Head should occupy approximately 40-50% of image height, positioned x=62%-91%, y=14%-66%, with shoulders fading naturally into the dark arena around y=80%. Add cinematic silver rim light and red reflections from the arena so the photo feels integrated into this WWE-inspired game key art. Keep enough contrast for the bruises and eyes to be clearly visible. STRICT INVARIANTS: Preserve the entire LEFT HALF including the exact five-character metallic title "暴打严俊杰" (top line 暴打, second line 严俊杰), THE MAIN EVENT small text, red underline, and dark empty lower-left zone for the live start button. Do not cover any title lettering. Keep the red ring ropes and stadium visible around/behind the right-side headshot, preserve landscape aspect ratio, original red-black-silver visual style, and original background composition where practical. No additional text, buttons, cards, interface elements, watermark or other people. Output the complete composite banner ready for direct use as the game homepage background.
